author: AR6420
name: GEMM Boundary Fusion: MLP + Attention Kernel Fusion
blurb: Fuses element-wise ops (RMSNorm, LeakyReLU^2, RoPE, residual-add) INTO Triton GEMM boundaries as prologues/epilogues. 3 custom kernels: fused_mlp_up_proj (GEMM+LeakyReLU^2, 1.39x), fused_mlp_down_proj (GEMM+scale+residual, 1.13x), fused_qk_norm_rope (RMSNorm+RoPE+gain, 2.37x). Projected 2.64ms/step savings (3.0%) over SOTA baseline. Evolved from PR#1316's megakernel insight: fuse element-wise ops, but partner with cuBLAS-speed GEMMs instead of replacing them.
technique_summary: Triton GEMM + fused epilogue/prologue for MLP and attention element-wise ops
